name: vulos-management-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end test for the vulos-management OSS console: drives the REAL built SPA (web/dist) in headless Chromium against a stateful mock of the management JSON API. Isolated Node tooling — not part of the Go module. Proves self-host sign-in, portal-user vs operator role separation in the UI, and the admin-team grant/revoke + last-admin guard, asserting zero uncaught page errors.
